titulo: Listen before you speak: Group 1 — Allies

aula.objetivo: Recognise the first 12 Cyrillic sounds, read the first words, hear the stress and say the first sentences.

blocos.texto: You do not need to memorise anything. Listen, repeat, keep going. Russian will sound strange for a few minutes today and familiar by the end. First you hear the sounds, then you see the letters. By the end of this session you can read your first Russian words, like «мама» (MAH-mah) and «кот» (koht).

letras.som: like the «k» in «skip» (no puff of air)
like the «o» in «more», but shorter (when stressed)
like the «t» in «stop» (tongue on the back of the teeth, no puff of air)

blocos.titulo: Word stress: the syllable in charge
blocos.explicacao: STEP 1: Every Russian word with two or more syllables has one stronger syllable. It is longer, louder and clearer. This is called word stress. STEP 2: In books, stress is shown as a small mark over the strong vowel. In «мама» (MAH-mah), the strength is on the first «ма». Say it slowly: MAH-mah, with the force on «MAH». STEP 3: In «она» (ah-NAH), the strength is on the last syllable. Say: ah-NAH, with the force on «NAH». Notice that the place of the stress changes from one word to another. STEP 4: One-syllable words, like «как» (kahk) and «кто» (kto), are strong all the way through. There is nothing to choose. STEP 5: Russian stress has no fixed place and is almost never written. So whenever you learn a new word, listen to the audio and remember where the stress is. It decides how the vowels sound, and you will see that in session 3.
blocos.comparacao: in English, stress can change a word too: «REcord» (a noun) and «reCORD» (a verb), «PERmit» and «perMIT». Russian works the same way, except that the stress is almost never written.

exemplos.pt: mom: the stress is on the first «ма»
this is: the stress is on «э»
cat: one syllable only, strong all the way through

erros.motivo: In English, many words start with the strong syllable, so it is easy to put the stress first out of habit. In «она́» the strength falls on the last syllable: ah-NAH.

itens.explicacao: You heard two identical syllables, «ma-ma». «кто» and «как» have only one syllable.
The middle sound is «o»: k-o-t. In «кто» the «т» comes before the «о», and «тот» starts with «т».
The word starts with the k sound (letter «к»). «так» starts with t.
It starts and ends with t: tot. «кот» starts with k and «так» ends with k.

itens.enunciado: Read the word «кот». What does it mean?
itens.explicacao: Read letter by letter: «к» (k), «о» (o), «т» (t). Together: kot, cat. «мама» is mom and «как» is how.

itens.enunciado: Which letter makes the «m» sound, as in «mom»?
itens.explicacao: «М» is the letter in «мама». «Т» makes the t sound and «К» makes the k sound.
The answer is about a person, the mother. So the question is «who»: «Кто».
The question asks for a person. «мама» answers it; «как» and «кто» are question words.
As in English, the question word comes first: «Кто» (who), then «это» (this).
Write letter by letter: м, а, м, а. The word repeats the pair «ма».

itens.enunciado: Read «тот кот» aloud and write what it means in English.

blocos.enunciado: Listen to each word and repeat it 3 times, with the stress in the right place: «мама, как, кто, это, тот, кот». Then cover the transliteration and read only the Cyrillic aloud. Finally, point to a family photo and ask «Кто это?».
Without looking at the screen, say aloud the sound of each of the 5 letters: «а, к, м, о, т». Then write «мама» by hand, letter by letter.
